svg.text: Orange = electrical pad 1/01. It does not universally mean cathode or positive.
Match IC dots, diode bands, capacitor polarity and connector keys to the exact package drawing.
Grey outlines show pad envelopes, not component bodies. Check orientation_review.csv before assembly.
118 source footprints on this side. No bench, package, solder-paste or machine-rotation approval is implied.
